title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation consolidates specialist models into one student at the price of rollouts, teacher passes and gradient steps for every teacher. We show that the consolidation does not need training: with forward passes only, the capabilities of separately tuned specialists can be aggregated into one model that is, on average, more accurate than either specialist alone. When specialists share a base model, distillation has an exact layer-wise solution: each linear layer of the fused model must reproduce every specialist's output on the inputs that specialist receives while reading its own answers, a least-squares problem whose solution needs only the second moments of those inputs. One forward pass over a few hundred rollouts provides them. We call this training-free on-policy distillation (\method). What the rollouts contain matters more than the solver: answers truncated in repetition loops are few among a mathematics specialist

translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏需要为每个教师模型进行采样、教师前向传播和梯度更新，才能将专家模型整合到一个学生模型中。我们证明这种整合其实不需要训练：仅通过前向传播，就可以将分别微调的多个专家模型的能力聚合到一个模型中，该模型平均而言比任何一个单独的专家模型都更加准确。当专家模型共享同一个基础模型时，蒸馏存在一个精确的逐层解：融合模型的每个线性层必须在专家模型所接收的输入上复现该专家的输出（同时读取其自身的答案），这是一个最小二乘问题，其解只需要这些输入的二阶矩。对几百个采样样本进行一次前向传播即可获得这些二阶矩。我们将这一方法称为免训练在策略蒸馏。相比求解器，采样样本中所包含的内容更为重要：在重复循环中被截断的回答在数学专家模型的采样中只占少数。
tldr: 本文提出免训练的在策略蒸馏方法，当多个专家模型共享同一基础模型时，仅需通过几百个采样样本的一次前向传播、以最小二乘方式逐层融合，即可在无需任何梯度训练的情况下将多个专家的能力聚合到一个模型中，且平均准确率超过任何单一专家模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes training-free on-policy distillation, which aggregates the capabilities of multiple specialist models sharing a base model into a single model without any gradient-based training, using only one forward pass over a few hundred rollouts to solve an exact layer-wise least-squares problem, yielding a fused model that is on average more accurate than either specialist alone.
